d: The Saraswati River is one of the biggest mysteries of Indian history. Mentioned as the greatest river in the Rigveda, it is believed to have flowed between the Yamuna and Sutlej before disappearing into the desert. Was the Ghaggar-Hakra the real Saraswati? Why did hundreds of Harappan cities flourish along its banks? And how did the idea of a hidden Saraswati at the Prayagraj Sangam begin?
